name: Rocky Valley, Massive Doors
desc1: This is the end of the narrow, rocky valley through the Dragon's Teeth
desc2: hills. It terminates in a sheer wall, its face broken by a pair of
desc3: massive black doors, towering some twenty feet above you. Small
desc4: spy-holes can be seen above the door, and occasionally you notice some
desc5: movement behind them. Aside from the huge doors, the only exit is up
desc6: the valley floor to the north.
